name: workflow-engine
notes: Kotlin/Spring Boot 4.1, Java 25, Gradle. make dev stops any running engine on 47831, starts compose Postgres on 127.0.0.1:55434, runs bootRun and opens the console. DATABASE_URL is JDBC form. Swagger at /docs. Browser console at /. Auth is the X-User header; dev users and roles come from workflow.rbac.grants in application.yaml (stub until the central rbac service). Two sample workflows call the demo providers on localhost:47831 by hard-coded URL. Tests use Testcontainers (Docker required).
